title: Built-in graphics held to a memory line in every year
items: A computer on built-in graphics, like an Intel UHD 630 desktop, is now held to a memory line in 1835 and 1812 as well as 1904. Each year keeps its people, horses and carriages.
A computer drawing without its graphics driver, such as Windows with only the Microsoft Basic Render Driver, now starts at Balanced with the memory saver on. Before, it started at Full.
